column3: “This time” is supplied; exceedingly renders the phrase great to God.
“On the first day of his journey” rearranges the beginning of the entry into the city for a day’s journey.
“Eat” replaces graze; water is not specified.
“Have everyone” supplies a distinct subject for calling out; ways pluralizes way.
The evil way is pluralized; the final statement that He did not do it is omitted.
